65e23f340d4561000821540d: Mister Rogers plants a seed and visits a conservatory. King Friday orders Handyman Negri to sing a song about not being afraid. This makes the neighbors even more anxious about the “big thing” that is to arrive in the neighborhood.

Mister Rogers brings in a cat named Jimmy and remembers him as a kitten. He shows pictures of babies that have grown into adults. Everyone gathers at the castle just as the big thing rolls into the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

Mister Rogers says that the bean plant he planted a few days ago has grown. Robert Troll is the only one who can communicate with the “big thing.” He learns that it wants a blanket; the blanket causes it to sprout a stem and leaves.

Mister Rogers plays games that require patience.  Purple Panda experiments with a powder that causes flowers to grow. Prince Tuesday wishes the powder to make him grow. Mister Rogers goes to see the Harlem Spiritual Ensemble practice.
Harriett Cow shares the plans for a play. Lady Aberlin is greeted by a ballet dancer who dances her around the Neighborhood. The dancer inspires Ana Platypus to be a ballerina in the school play.

Mister Rogers explains why he changes into a sweater and sneakers, and shows how people make sweaters and sneakers. Miss Paulificate brings Prince Tuesday's ragdoll to life by dancing with him. The neighbors decide their roles in a play.
Mister Rogers plays dress-up with wigs and glasses, and says: “You can get dressed up in the fanciest of things, but the best style comes from inside, and it often spreads on your face with a smile.”

King Friday suggests that the Neighborhood of Make-Believe be turned upside down to see if the missing crown might fall out. Trolley finds the spare crown! Mister Rogers visits the Boys Choir of Harlem.

Maggie Stewart is dressed as Mr. McFeely and delivers a film about how people make sweaters. The children put on a play about a princess, a raccoon and a giant king. Prince Tuesday admits he had something to do with the missing crown.

Mister Rogers sees Bob Trow paint a portrait of Mr. McFeely. Robert Troll paints a portrait of King Friday who asks Lady Aberlin to have everyone copy it for themselves. Lady Aberlin explains that art comes from within each person.

Mister Rogers arrives with a wooden toy airplane. Handyman Negri is working on a musical portrait of King Friday. Neighbor Aber provides his own tribute to King Friday as he mans his plane and draws a sky-written portrait of the King.
Mister Rogers shows a picture of a blue tree. In art, you can make things any way you want. He also talks about visiting art museums.
Mister Rogers "colors a song" by playing music by Mozart to inspire his artwork. King Friday is curious about a delivery to X the Owl labelled "Deliver to X the Owl ONLY."

Mister Rogers sees Bob Trow approaching with his imaginary dog.  Robert Troll and his imaginary pet, Gloria, are visiting with Queen Sara. When the Queen departs for a meeting, Gloria disappears into the castle.

Mister Rogers shows  a video about people who make umbrellas. It's raining in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe and Neighbor Aber is interested in a special sale at the factory where Corney has manufactured Umbrella Rockits.

Marilyn Barnett stops by for some sitting down exercises. Prince Tuesday asks Handyman Negri to help bring his ragdoll to life. Corney has made a new (imaginary) umbrella Rockit for Daniel's imaginary friend, Malcolm Apricot Dinko.
Mister Rogers delights in a visitor who can whistle, especially because that's something Mister Rogers hasn't been able to learn. Nobody can do everything!

Mister Rogers talks and sings about wondering and being curious, which is important for learning! Jazz saxophonist Eric Kloss, who is blind, shows how he uses a special machine called the Kurzweil Personal Reader!

Elevators and escalators - Mister Rogers shows some toy machines, and rides on real ones that lift people and cars. There's even a hydraulic platform delivered by Mr. McFeely in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

A domino display artist sets up thousands of dominoes. When one is knocked over, they all go down in a fascinating pattern. Lady Elaine's elevator in Make-Believe takes Robert Troll up in the air as if he's flying.
Flags, marbles, a slide – so many things go up and down. Mister Rogers learns some up and down exercises from Neighbor Marilyn Barnett and Kara, a young ballerina.

A visit with world famous clarinetist, Richard Stoltzman, who makes music playing notes that go up and down. In Make-Believe, there's hope that an elevator operator will solve the up and down problem at Lady Elaine's Museum-Go-Round.

Balloon artist, Bruce Franco, blows up balloons into animal shapes. It takes a lot of practice to be able to make fancy things like that from balloons. Then, Mr. McFeely and Mayor Maggie go up in the air for a hot-air balloon ride.

Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make stuffed bears. Mr. McFeely encounters someone dressed in a bear costume.  Daniel recognizes that the bear is a person in costume and realizes that person is Lady Aberlin.

Visiting the Neighborhood aviary, Mister Rogers sees a variety of birds. King Friday scolds his birds as they fail to meet his exercise expectations. Mayor Maggie invites the birds to join her as she goes to the new "Museum of Love."

Mister Rogers takes out a wooden block and talks about when he was young and would use a block to pretend he was shaving. At Negri's Music Shop, mandolinist Peter Ostroushko sings a Ukrainian lullaby.
Mister Rogers blows some bubbles and calls a plumber because the water in his house isn't working.

Prince Tuesday is concerned when he sees a small toy Trolley on the tracks. Robert Troll picks it up and tells the prince that the real Trolley is playing at Daniel's clock.  Daniel shares that the Trolley can do some "magical things."
Jim West, a shadow artist, creates silhouettes of various animals. King Friday asks Robert Troll to help him by return some shadows that were left behind at the castle by various Neighbors.

5ff4b9ccf938f8000779eb99: ¡Luffy y Law han caído en una trampa y están atrapados en el fondo de un pozo! ¡Y quien acudirá en su ayuda será quien menos se esperaban!
Los oficiales de la Familia Doflamingo aparecen ante Luffy y los demás y comienza una enorme batalla a gran escala.

El ataque de los rufianes permite que Luffy y los demás se acerquen al palacio. Mientras, Kin'emon finalmente se reúne con Kanjuro, el otro samurái del Reino de Wano. Y para poder salir del basurero subterráneo, Kanjuro hace una brujería sorprendente.
Un ejército de muñecos bloquea el camino de Luffy y su grupo. Mientras tanto, Pica está luchando contra Zoro y lanza un puñetazo gigante hacia Robin y los demás que se dirigen al palacio.
Los Tontatta están eufóricos tras haber sido liberados de la fábrica de SMILE. Pero la preocupación y la confusión aumentan porque no conocen el paradero de la princesa Mansherry.

Violet finalmente localiza a la princesa Mansherry usando su clarividencia. Y mientras le da esperanzas a Leo, Luffy y los demás se ven rodeados por esos extraños muñecos que no dejan de atacar por más que los venzan una y otra vez.
Sabo intenta averiguar las intenciones de Fujitora mientras pelea duramente contra él.

El oficial de mayor rango, Diamante, lanza poderosos ataques que Rebecca apenas puede resistir. ¡Cuando por fin la acorrala, a instantes de perder su inocente vida, aparece el legendario e invicto guerrero Kyros en el Campo de Girasoles!
Sugar se aproxima a Luffy y Law con sed de venganza. "¡No dejaré que los conviertan en juguetes!". Con ese pensamiento en su mente, Usopp le apunta a Sugar, que está más allá de su campo visual.
Luffy y Law por fin enfrentan a su enemigo jurado, Doflamingo. Provocándolos con ingenio para que hagan lo que quiere, Doflamingo los ataca manipulando a Bellamy.

Luffy y Law pasan a la ofensiva tras lograr su plan secreto. Pero la ira de Doflamingo llega al límite y lanza un contraataque terrible que acorrala a los dos de nuevo. Luffy y Law se enteran de la impactante verdad sobre Doflamingo, el Shichibukai.
Cuando Luffy y Law no pueden hacer nada y va a empezar su ejecución ante Doflamingo, se revela el secreto de la fruta Ope Ope que puede hacer temblar al mundo y el impactante pasado de Law.

Flevance, la patria de Law, era un sitio admirado, hermoso y blanco como un país de nieve. Pero esa hermosa patria se vuelve una zona de guerra y desaparece del mapa. Ahora sabremos todas las adversidades por las que pasó Law cuando era niño.

Doflamingo nació siendo uno de los Dragones Celestiales, los gobernantes del mundo. ¿Por qué perdió su posición de nobleza? Cuando se revela el inimaginable pasado de Doflamingo, la vida del joven Law sufre un gran cambio.

Mientras Law se acerca a su muerte, Corazón y él salen en búsqueda de una cura para su enfermedad. Tras un largo y doloroso viaje, Corazón empieza a hablar desde su corazón y, a partir de ese momento, nace un profundo vínculo entre ellos.

¡A Law le queda muy poco tiempo! Corazón planea enemistarse con todo el mundo para robar la fruta Ope Ope y así salvar a Law y vivir con él. La pelea en la que Corazón arriesgará su vida empezará en la fatídica Isla Minion.
Corazon por fin consigue la fruta Ope Ope y se la da a Law para que se la coma, aunque no tiene un efecto inmediato.
La Familia Don Quixote acorrala a Corazón, quien finalmente enfrenta a Doflamingo. Cuando Corazón arriesga su vida para luchar... el joven Law empieza a caminar hacia la libertad.

Cora-san abrió un camino al futuro para Law sacrificando su propia vida.Law hereda su deseo y, con el fin de ser verdaderamente libre, lanza un ataque a Doflamingo que Cora-san no pudo lanzar ese día.

Law lanza ataques mostrando sus apasionadas emociones por el difunto Cora-san. Pero cuando Doflamingo hace una sonrisa temeraria al recibir esos violentos ataques, un terrible contraataque hace que Law caiga en un abismo de desesperación.

Los salvajes ataques de Machvise dejan gravemente herido a Hajrudin y lo hacen desplomarse. Pero cuando el gigante lastimado vuelve a levantarse para pagar su deuda con Luffy, resuena un ataque letal que contiene todo el alma de Elbaf.
